Author: kaldigo
Name: Aetherform
Punchline: Install the Aetherform body and build collection-specific physics presets.
Description: Use /aetherform to install the body through Penumbra, select a collection, adjust physics, and fit vanilla gear on equip.
Changelog: Vanilla gear now uses the Aetherform body morph, local cloth density, native AF skin cuts, shared animated seams and clearance checks. Classification updates refresh generated fits. Earlier editable fits remain available.
